acceptance_criterion: A user with valid credentials is authenticated and a session is created that carries their role
test_name: returns the user and role on success, and records last-login

acceptance_criterion: An incorrect email or an incorrect password is rejected with the same message
test_name: gives the same message for a wrong email as for a wrong password

acceptance_criterion: A rejection caused by a deactivated account is distinguishable from a rejection caused by wrong credentials
test_name: distinguishes a deactivated account from bad credentials

acceptance_criterion: On a failed login attempt no session is created and no last-login timestamp is recorded
test_name: records no last-login timestamp on a failed attempt

acceptance_criterion: On successful login the last-login timestamp and the authenticated user are recorded
test_name: records the last-login timestamp on success

acceptance_criterion: Logging out ends the session; navigating back to a protected page afterwards does not display any event data
test_name: revokes the session and returns 204

acceptance_criterion: An attempt by a user whose role is not permitted is refused: the action does not execute and no record is created or modified
test_name: refuses a role that is not an Event Coordinator (A2)

acceptance_criterion: The refusal applies to a direct URL or API call, not only to hidden menu items
test_name: refuses a role that is not an Event Coordinator (A2)

acceptance_criterion: An Event Organiser's event list contains only events where that organiser is the recorded owner
test_name: scopes an Organiser's events list to events they own (AC1)

acceptance_criterion: An Event Coordinator's list contains all events in the system, regardless of which coordinator is assigned
test_name: gives a Coordinator every event, not filtered by assignment (AC2)

acceptance_criterion: Venue Staff see booking requests and confirmed bookings for their own venues
test_name: scopes Venue Staff's venue bookings to their own venues (AC3)

acceptance_criterion: Technical Support Staff see equipment requests and reservations
test_name: scopes Tech Support's equipment requests to what they handle (AC4)

acceptance_criterion: An Attendee sees only events with registration enabled that are open to them
test_name: scopes an Attendee's events list to open-for-registration only (AC5)

acceptance_criterion: Filtering is applied when the list is retrieved, so a request for an event outside the user's relationship returns no event data at all
test_name: resolves an Organiser's events scope to their own events

acceptance_criterion: The scope rule is applied when the list is retrieved, so an event outside the caller's relationship returns no event data at all
test_name: gives a user outside the event's scope no event data (A3)

acceptance_criterion: An Event Organiser's event list contains only events where that organiser is the recorded owner, applied as a query-time filter
test_name: gives an organiser no data at all for another organiser's event

acceptance_criterion: The request captures event name, purpose, description, proposed date, start and end time, expected attendance, venue requirements, accessibility needs, equipment requirements, and whether registration is required
test_name: shows the full submitted content, including requirements

acceptance_criterion: On a successful submission the request is stored with status Submitted, and the submitting organiser, submission timestamp, and a unique event reference are recorded
test_name: stores the request as Submitted with a reference and a submission time

acceptance_criterion: The submitting organiser is recorded as the owner of the event
test_name: records the submitting organiser as the owner of the event

acceptance_criterion: The submitted request appears in the Event Coordinator review queue
test_name: shows a submitted request with the details a coordinator triages on

acceptance_criterion: On submission the assigned coordinator (E1) is notified that a new event request is awaiting review
test_name: raises the notification that a new request awaits review, in the same transaction

acceptance_criterion: If submission fails validation, no event record is created and no submission timestamp is recorded
test_name: creates no event record at all when validation fails (B1, B2)

acceptance_criterion: Submission is blocked unless every mandatory field is populated
test_name: names every missing mandatory field, not only the first

acceptance_criterion: When submission is blocked, the message names every field that caused the rejection, not just the first one
test_name: names every field that caused the rejection, not just the first (B2)

acceptance_criterion: The end date/time must be later than the start date/time; an equal or earlier end time is rejected and the message identifies this as the reason
test_name: rejects an end time equal to the start time, saying why

acceptance_criterion: The proposed start date/time must not be in the past at the moment of submission
test_name: rejects a start date and time in the past

acceptance_criterion: Expected attendance must be a whole number greater than zero
test_name: rejects an expected attendance of zero

acceptance_criterion: When registration is required, the opening and closing date/times are mandatory and the closing must be later than the opening
test_name: requires the closing to be later than the opening

acceptance_criterion: The registration closing must be no later than the event start
test_name: requires the closing to be no later than the event start

acceptance_criterion: An equipment-required flag is mandatory, and none-required counts as a complete equipment arrangement
test_name: accepts 'no equipment required' as a stated equipment flag

acceptance_criterion: A blocked submission creates no submission record and changes no other stored value
test_name: creates no event record at all when validation fails (B1, B2)

acceptance_criterion: A request can be saved once the event name is present; every other field may be empty
test_name: saves a draft with only a name, every other field empty

acceptance_criterion: The saved record has status Draft and stores the owning organiser and a last-saved timestamp
test_name: records the owning organiser and a last-saved timestamp

acceptance_criterion: The submission validation rules in B2 are not applied on save
test_name: does not apply the submission rules on save

acceptance_criterion: Any date or time that is entered must be a valid date or time
test_name: refuses a date that is not a valid date, even on save

acceptance_criterion: A draft does not appear in the Event Coordinator review queue
test_name: never shows a draft in the queue

acceptance_criterion: A draft is not visible to any user other than its owner
test_name: gives an organiser who does not own the draft no draft content

acceptance_criterion: Opening one of my own drafts restores every previously saved field with the exact value that was saved
test_name: restores every saved field with the exact value that was saved

acceptance_criterion: Saving an edited draft updates the last-saved timestamp and retains status Draft
test_name: keeps the draft a draft when it is edited and saved

acceptance_criterion: Submitting from a draft applies the full validation in B2
test_name: applies the full B2 validation when submitting from a draft

acceptance_criterion: On success the status changes Draft to Submitted and the submission timestamp is recorded
test_name: moves the draft to Submitted and records the submission time

acceptance_criterion: After submission the request is no longer editable through the draft screen
test_name: stops the request being edited through the draft screen once submitted

acceptance_criterion: A user who is not the owning organiser cannot open, edit, or submit the draft
test_name: refuses an edit by an organiser who does not own the draft

acceptance_criterion: The organiser's event list shows the status of every request, with Draft visually distinct from Submitted and later statuses
test_name: shows the status of every request, with drafts distinct from submitted ones

acceptance_criterion: The list can be filtered to show only drafts or only submitted-and-later requests
test_name: can be filtered to drafts only

acceptance_criterion: A draft row shows its last-saved date/time and displays no assigned coordinator, no review outcome, and no event reference number
test_name: shows a draft row with its last-saved time, no reference and no coordinator

acceptance_criterion: The list contains only the signed-in organiser's own requests
test_name: lists no other organiser's requests (A3)

acceptance_criterion: The queue lists every event with status Submitted, Under Review, or Awaiting Clarification that has no recorded decision
test_name: drops an event from the queue once it carries a decision

acceptance_criterion: Each row shows event reference, name, proposed date and time, expected attendance, submitting organiser, submission timestamp, and current status
test_name: shows a submitted request with the details a coordinator triages on

acceptance_criterion: The queue is ordered by submission timestamp, oldest first, by default
test_name: orders the queue oldest submission first

acceptance_criterion: Opening a request shows the full submitted content, including accessibility, venue, and equipment requirements
test_name: shows the full submitted content, including requirements

acceptance_criterion: Opening a request with status Submitted changes it to Under Review and records the reviewing coordinator and the timestamp
test_name: moves a Submitted request to Under Review, recording the reviewer and time

acceptance_criterion: If the request is already Under Review by another coordinator, the reviewer on the record is not overwritten
test_name: does not overwrite the reviewer when a second coordinator opens it

acceptance_criterion: Requests with status Draft never appear in the queue
test_name: never shows a draft in the queue

acceptance_criterion: Assignment happens automatically as part of the submission of an event request (B1)
test_name: assigns a coordinator as part of the submission

acceptance_criterion: Exactly one coordinator is assigned per event
test_name: gives each event exactly one active assignment

acceptance_criterion: On assignment the assigned coordinator, the allocation rule applied, and the assignment timestamp are recorded
test_name: records the allocation rule that was applied, so the outcome can be explained

acceptance_criterion: The allocation rule is applied consistently to every event
test_name: assigns each coordinator in turn as the cursor advances

acceptance_criterion: The newly assigned coordinator receives a notification identifying the event
test_name: notifies the newly assigned coordinator

acceptance_criterion: If no eligible coordinator exists, the event is still submitted and recorded as awaiting assignment
test_name: returns nothing when no eligible coordinator exists, so the event can still be submitted

acceptance_criterion: Every status change writes a history entry containing previous status, new status, the acting user, their role, the timestamp, and the triggering action
test_name: writes the first status history entry for the submission (F1)

acceptance_criterion: An attempted transition that is not permitted from the current status is refused, and the message names the current status and the attempted target
test_name: names the current status and the attempted target when it refuses

acceptance_criterion: An Event Coordinator's list contains all events in the system, with the events assigned to them distinguishable from the rest
test_name: lists every event whoever it is assigned to, marking the coordinator's own

acceptance_criterion: Events assigned to the coordinator are distinguishable in the review queue
test_name: marks the events assigned to the signed-in coordinator

acceptance_criterion: The request captures venue requirements and equipment requirements
test_name: stores the venue and equipment requirements it captures (B1)

acceptance_criterion: The request form captures venue requirements and equipment requirements
test_name: sends venue requirements as a layout, a list of facilities and notes

acceptance_criterion: The submitting organiser is shown to the organiser
test_name: shows the submitting organiser on the organiser's own request page

acceptance_criterion: A blocked submission leaves the request at status Draft and changes no other stored value
test_name: stores none of the sent values when the submission is blocked (B2)

acceptance_criterion: A request can be saved once the event name is present; a name of spaces is not a name
test_name: refuses a draft whose name is only spaces, since that is no name at all

acceptance_criterion: Submitting from a draft applies the full validation in B2 to the values being submitted
test_name: validates the sent values rather than the stored ones, naming an emptied name

acceptance_criterion: Each row shows the submitting organiser
test_name: names the submitting organiser in the review queue

acceptance_criterion: If the request is already Under Review by another coordinator, the name of that coordinator is displayed
test_name: names the coordinator who opened the request first

acceptance_criterion: Opening a request shows the full submitted content, including venue and equipment requirements
test_name: restores saved requirements into the form
